contracts.purpose: Start a bounded agent runtime session from an MCP client or local orchestration layer.
contracts.approval_boundary: approval-policy must be recorded and cannot silently widen sandbox access
contracts.sandbox_boundary: sandbox must be read-only, workspace-write, or danger-full-access with explicit evidence

contracts.purpose: Continue an existing agent runtime session.
contracts.approval_boundary: approval prompts must carry the same threadId for audit correlation
contracts.sandbox_boundary: inherits original session boundary unless explicitly reconfigured and audited
